title: Lower block, ARC, error, task, and actor surfaces through runtime-backed IR helpers

mode_matrix.name: native-runtime-backed-semantics
abi_requirements: Objc3RuntimeBackedSemanticsClosureSummary emits contract objc3c.runtime.backed.semantics.closure.v1 with block, ARC, error, continuation, task, and actor runtime-backed model strings

Objc3IREmitter publishes a runtime_backed_semantics_closure IR comment in the same native lowering stream as runnable_block_execution_matrix, runnable_arc_closeout, error_handling_live_error_runtime_integration, concurrency_live_task_runtime_integration, and actor metadata contracts
Per-fixture IR evidence includes concrete __objc3_block_copy_helper_ and __objc3_block_dispose_helper_ call sites for source constructs that require block copy/dispose lowering

The closure report compiles seven representative positive native fixtures and requires source-specific IR call tokens from block promotion/copy-dispose, ARC retain/release/autorelease/weak/autoreleasepool, error runtime bridge, continuation runtime, task runtime, and actor mailbox/replay surfaces

Runtime-import surface artifacts are checked for the relevant block ownership, ARC cleanup, error replay, and actor mailbox/isolation helper payloads instead of treating report-only or declaration-only tokens as support
The private helper boundary contains exactly 36 helper symbols and no public runtime ABI widening is claimed by this fixture
runtime_requirements: objc3_runtime_promote_block_i32 backs escaping block promotion while emitted block descriptors point at concrete invoke thunks
objc3_runtime_retain_i32, objc3_runtime_release_i32, objc3_runtime_autorelease_i32, weak current-property helpers, and autoreleasepool push/pop helpers back the ARC slice
objc3_runtime_store_thrown_error_i32, objc3_runtime_load_thrown_error_i32, bridge helpers, and catch-match helpers back thrown/error propagation

continuation, task-group, cancellation, executor-hop, mailbox, replay-proof, race-guard, and nonisolated actor helper calls are present in the owning fixture IR, while the actor runtime-import artifact preserves isolation, hop, executor-affinity, replay, and race-guard metadata

abi_field_stability.stability_property: The emitted runtime_backed_semantics_closure contract id must remain objc3c.runtime.backed.semantics.closure.v1 until an intentional version bump
The report and IR summary agree on the exact 36-symbol private helper set before broader support claims can be widened
